location_description:
East Dundee is a village in Kane County with a small section in Cook County.  The population was 3,152 at the 2020 census.


== Geography ==
East Dundee is located at 42°06′07″N 88°16′13″W.According to the 2021 census gazetteer files, East Dundee has a total area of 3.15 square miles (8.16 km2), of which 2.91 square miles (7.54 km2) (or 92.36%) is land and 0.24 square miles (0.62 km2) (or 7.64%) is water.
